notes: Partition verified: all 45 source ids and all 54 target ids occur exactly once. The alignment itself is correct and stands.

The accepted review note miscounts: it says "two articles go unrendered" and then names only one. The correct tally is a single unrendered article, s033 (הַ of הַסֹּפֵר, since the ASV writes *a writer's inkhorn* with no *the*), and a single unrendered waw, s015 (no connective before *every man*). s009 and s044 each take a written *the*.

s007/s009 follow rule 29's multi-level chain: the article on הָעֶלְיוֹן takes the *the* standing before *upper*, and the second English *the* in *the way of the upper gate* is the supplied one on the outer construct דֶּרֶךְ. s043/s044 follow the fronting clause of the same rule: the one written *the* of *the brazen altar* belongs to the present article on נְחֹשֶׁת, not to the construct מִזְבַּח.

s014's directive he is tagged Sd and takes the ASV's *toward* as its own unit under rule 32, not the paragogic-he treatment of that rule's first sentence; the supplied *the* before *north* goes to the nominal expression under rule 15.
s031's waw takes *with*, which rule 14 lists explicitly, so it is not added; s039 keeps the phrasal particle *in* with *went* under rule 44.
